reasons: The promql applies a hard-coded scale `/ 1e7` that is not in the Datadog source. The converter must not apply unit scales in promql; it should note the scale (ns/s to percent, i.e. /1e9 then x100) in notes with a documentation link.
container.cpu.usage.usermode is a monotonic sum in ns, so rate() over $__rate_interval is valid, and the grouping by container_name matches the Datadog `by {container_name}`.
Datadog avg is replaced by sum; this is equivalent only if each container_name has a single series in the dataset, which should be stated as a caveat.
The `$scope` template variable has no prefix and default `*`, so dropping it is correct.
